concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Setup and first end‑to‑end analysis
concerns.text: Tasks T003 and T004 are marked `[P1]` (parallel‑safe) but both depend on the output of earlier tasks (T002 provides the elemental property file needed by T003, and T004 depends on the demo pipeline built in T003). Running them in parallel could cause failures, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Complete the study and validate its evidence
concerns.text: All tasks in Phase 2 (T005‑T010) are tagged `[P2]` or `[P3]` yet they form a strict sequential chain (e.g., T006 requires the merged dataset from T005, T007 requires the cleaned data from T006, T008 requires features from T007, etc.). The `[P]` tags are therefore unsafe and must be removed or the tasks re‑structured to truly be parallel‑independent.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – Reproducible results and paper handoff
concerns.text: Tasks T011‑T013 are also marked `[P3]` but each consumes artifacts produced by the entire preceding pipeline (e.g., T011 needs the JSON metrics from T009, T012 re‑executes the full pipeline, and T013 records hashes of all prior outputs). These cannot be safely executed in parallel with other tasks.

The project constitution (Principle II – Verified Accuracy) requires a Reference‑Validator gate before any artifact that introduces or modifies citations is created. No task in the current list implements this validation step, leaving the constitution unfulfilled. A dedicated task (e.g., `T000 Verify citations with Reference‑Validator`) should be added before any task that writes files containing citations.
